summary: Play Princess Castle World - Dream House Town Dollhouse Games for Girls!
description:
Welcome to Princess Castle World where you can play in a Pretend Princess Dream House and Town Dollhouse Game for Girls!
Join Princess Castle World fun with Amelia where you can explore many rooms and places including her very own enchanted Castle in a Dollhouse style game!
Decorate and design her home and castle the way you love with her beloved family and friends joining!
More Castles and Worlds to be added in the future for an Amazingly fulfilling Adventure in Princess Amelia's Castle World!

~ Princess Amelia's Castle features over 15 rooms total to start with new Castles to be added in the future including an Ice Castle, her BFF's Purple Castle, and more!
~ Beautiful graphics and sounds with an amazing soundtrack from some very well known artists to enjoy while playing this beautiful game!
~ Pretend style gameplay and easy to use mechanics!
~ Play in portrait mode which is unique to the dollhouse genre!
~ Take Princess Amelia's Castle World with you anywhere in the world and play at home, in the car, on the airplane and more!
~ Princess Amelia is the best pocket game out there for Dollhouse lovers and creative home designers!
